name: la-vigie
description: Local desktop app to manage parallel AI coding agents and their git worktrees
author: evermax

scripts.tauri:dev: npm install && npm run tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: npm install && npm run tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:unsigned: npm install && npm run tauri build -- --config "{\"bundle\":{\"macOS\":{\"signingIdentity\":\"-\"}}}"

_comment_overrides: @wdio/tauri-service@1.2.0 pins @wdio/native-utils@2.4.0 but imports installMockSyncOverride, which only lands in 2.5.0 (upstream release skew, TASK-142). Force 2.5.0. serialize-javascript forced to a patched version: mocha@10.8.2 pulls serialize-javascript@6.0.2, vulnerable to RCE (GHSA-5c6j-r48x-rmvq) and DoS (GHSA-qj8w-gfj5-8c6v), both only fixed in >=7.0.5; the API is unchanged 6->7 so mocha's parallel-worker serialization is unaffected. typed-rest-client pulls qs, forced to a patched version: GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx / GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g fixed only in >=6.16.0.
